dataset_name: Meta Company-wise Coding Interview Preparation Bank
focus: Meta-style coding preparation: arrays, strings, hash maps, two pointers, sliding windows, graph traversal and optimization.
note: 2,000 entries: 100 representative core coding problems plus 1,900 generated practice variants (19 variants per core problem). Variants are not independently verified historical interview questions. Company tags indicate preparation relevance, not official endorsement. No code solutions included.

questions.problem_statement: Return the indices of two distinct array elements whose values add up to a target. Assume exactly one answer unless otherwise specified.
Group words that are anagrams of one another. The order of groups does not matter.
Determine whether every opening bracket in a string is closed by the correct type and in the correct order.
questions.output_format: true if the bracket sequence is valid.

questions.problem_statement: Count connected components of land in a grid. Adjacent land cells are connected horizontally or vertically.
questions.input_format: A grid of '1' land and '0' water cells.

questions.problem_statement: Find the length of the longest contiguous substring containing no repeated characters.
Count the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals a target integer K.
questions.input_format: An integer array and target K.

questions.problem_statement: Find the shortest substring of a source string containing every character of a target string with required multiplicities.
questions.input_format: Source string s and target string t.
questions.output_format: The minimum window or an empty string.

questions.problem_statement: For each index, return the product of all array elements except the element at that index, without using division.
questions.output_format: An output array of equal length.

questions.problem_statement: For every contiguous window of size K, return the maximum value in that window.
questions.input_format: An integer array and window size K.

questions.problem_title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
questions.problem_statement: Given daily stock prices, choose one day to buy and a later day to sell to maximize profit. Return zero if no profit is possible.
Calculate the frequency of every distinct integer in an array.
questions.output_format: A mapping from each value to its frequency.

questions.problem_title: Find Largest and Smallest Array Values
questions.problem_statement: Find the minimum and maximum values in an array in one traversal.

questions.problem_title: Find Missing Number from 1 to N
questions.problem_statement: An array contains distinct integers from 1 through N with exactly one value missing. Find the missing value.
questions.input_format: N and an array of N-1 distinct integers.

questions.problem_statement: Given an integer array and a target, determine whether two distinct elements sum to the target.
questions.output_format: A matching pair of values or false.

questions.problem_statement: Find the second-largest distinct value in an integer array. Report when no such value exists.
questions.output_format: The second-largest distinct value or a defined no-answer result.

questions.problem_statement: Return the distinct values that appear in both integer arrays.
Merge two sorted integer arrays into one sorted array.
Move all zero values to the end of an array while preserving the relative order of non-zero elements.
Given a sorted array, remove duplicates in place and return the number of unique elements.
questions.output_format: The unique-element count and compacted prefix.

questions.problem_statement: Reverse the order of elements in an array without allocating another array proportional to its size.
Return all distinct values present in either of two integer arrays.
Given non-negative bar heights, calculate how much rainwater can be trapped between the bars.
An array of N+1 integers contains values from 1 through N. Find the repeated value without modifying the array and using constant extra space if possible.
questions.input_format: An integer array of length N+1.

questions.problem_statement: Given non-overlapping intervals sorted by start time and one new interval, insert it and merge all overlaps.
questions.input_format: A sorted interval list and a new interval.

questions.problem_statement: Find the value that appears more than floor(N/2) times, if such a value exists.
questions.output_format: The majority value or a defined no-answer result.

questions.problem_statement: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest product and return that product.
Find the maximum possible sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.
Rotate an array to the right by K positions. K may be larger than the array length.
questions.input_format: An integer array and non-negative K.

questions.problem_statement: Rotate an N by N matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place if possible.
If an element in a matrix is zero, set its entire row and column to zero, using constant extra space if possible.
Return all elements of a rectangular matrix in clockwise spiral order.
Find all unique triplets in an integer array whose sum is zero.
Determine whether a partially filled 9 by 9 Sudoku board is valid under row, column and 3 by 3 box rules.
questions.output_format: true if no rule is violated.

questions.problem_statement: Add two binary strings and return the binary sum without converting the entire input to a built-in large integer.
Determine whether two strings contain the same characters with the same frequencies. Treat letter case according to the stated input rule.
Determine whether one string is a rotation of another, with both strings having equal length.
Determine whether a given string reads identically from left to right and right to left, ignoring no characters unless stated.
questions.output_format: true if it is a palindrome; otherwise false.

questions.problem_statement: For each character in a string, calculate how many times it occurs.
Count vowels and consonants in a supplied alphabetic string. Ignore non-letter characters.
Find the first character in a string whose frequency is exactly one.
questions.output_format: The character or a defined no-answer result.

questions.problem_statement: Find the longest prefix shared by every string in a list. Return an empty string if none exists.
Remove repeated characters from a string while preserving the first occurrence order.
Given a string, reverse its characters without using a built-in reverse operation.
Compress consecutive repeated characters by writing each character followed by its run length. Return the compressed form only if it is shorter, if required by the specification.
questions.output_format: The compressed string or original string according to the rule.

questions.problem_title: Find All Permutations of a String
questions.problem_statement: Generate all distinct permutations of a string, avoiding duplicate outputs when characters repeat.
Find the longest contiguous palindromic substring in a given string.
Multiply two non-negative integers represented as decimal strings without using built-in big-integer multiplication.
questions.output_format: The product as a decimal string.

questions.problem_statement: Starting from a cell, recolor all 4-directionally connected cells having the original color.
questions.input_format: An image matrix, start row, start column and new color.

questions.problem_statement: Given a sorted list of words in an unknown language, infer a valid character ordering. Detect invalid prefix order or cycles.
questions.output_format: A valid character order or an empty/no-solution result.

questions.problem_statement: Find all edges in an undirected connected network whose removal increases the number of connected components.
Find the length of the shortest transformation sequence from a begin word to an end word, changing one letter at a time, with each intermediate word in a dictionary.
questions.input_format: Begin word, end word and word list.

questions.problem_statement: For each cell in a binary matrix, find the distance to the nearest zero cell.
questions.input_format: A binary matrix containing at least one zero.

questions.problem_statement: Compute shortest paths from a source in a weighted directed graph that may contain negative edges, and detect reachable negative cycles.
questions.input_format: Vertex count, weighted directed edges and source.

questions.problem_statement: Given courses and prerequisite pairs, determine whether all courses can be completed without a dependency cycle.
questions.output_format: true if all courses can be completed.

questions.problem_statement: Determine whether an undirected graph contains a cycle.
questions.input_format: Vertex count and undirected edge list.
questions.output_format: true if a cycle exists; otherwise false.

questions.problem_statement: Find shortest distances from a source vertex to every other vertex in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights.
Find the minimum total edge weight needed to connect all vertices of a connected, weighted, undirected graph.
Find the minimum number of edges from a source vertex to a target vertex in an unweighted graph. Return -1 if unreachable.
questions.input_format: An unweighted graph, source and target.

questions.problem_statement: Produce a valid topological ordering of a directed acyclic graph. If a cycle exists, report that no ordering is possible.
questions.output_format: A valid topological ordering or no-solution result.

questions.problem_statement: Process union operations on vertices and answer whether queried vertex pairs belong to the same connected component.
questions.output_format: A boolean answer for each connectivity query.

questions.problem_statement: Return the inorder traversal of a binary tree's node values.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.
questions.output_format: A list of values in inorder sequence.

questions.problem_statement: Find the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree, measured in edges.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.

questions.problem_statement: Compute the maximum number of nodes on a path from the root to any leaf.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.

questions.problem_statement: Determine whether a binary tree is a mirror image of itself around its center.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.

questions.problem_statement: Find the maximum sum of values along any non-empty path in a binary tree. A path may start and end at any nodes.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.

questions.problem_statement: Design methods to convert a binary tree into a string and reconstruct the same tree from that string.
questions.input_format: A binary tree and its serialized representation.
questions.output_format: A serialized string and reconstructed equivalent tree.

questions.problem_statement: Reconstruct a binary tree from its inorder and preorder traversal arrays, assuming all node values are distinct.
Replace each node value in a BST with the sum of all original values greater than or equal to that node's value.
Implement a prefix tree supporting insertion, exact-word search and prefix search.
questions.input_format: A sequence of insert, search and startsWith operations.
questions.output_format: The boolean results of search operations.

questions.problem_statement: Return the node values of a binary tree level by level from top to bottom.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.
questions.output_format: A list of lists, one per level.

questions.problem_statement: Given a BST and two existing nodes, find their lowest common ancestor.
questions.input_format: BST root and two target nodes.

questions.problem_statement: Determine whether a binary tree satisfies strict BST ordering for every node and its descendants.
questions.input_format: The root of a binary tree.
questions.output_format: true if it is a valid BST.

questions.problem_statement: Count the distinct ways to reach step N when each move advances either one or two steps.
Choose an order to burst balloons to maximize the coins collected, where each burst's score depends on its current neighbors.
questions.input_format: An array of positive balloon values.

questions.problem_statement: Find the minimum number of insertions, deletions and substitutions required to convert one string into another.
Implement matching for a string against a pattern supporting '.' and '*' with their standard single-character and repetition meanings.
questions.output_format: true if the entire string matches the pattern.

questions.problem_statement: Choose items with given weights and values to maximize total value without exceeding a capacity. Each item may be chosen at most once.
questions.input_format: Capacity and arrays of item weights and values.

questions.problem_statement: Given coin denominations and an amount, find the minimum number of coins needed to make the amount. Return -1 if impossible.
Count the ways to decode a digit string where 1 through 26 map to letters A through Z. Leading zeros must be handled correctly.
Given non-negative values in houses arranged in a line, maximize the amount collected without choosing adjacent houses.
Find the length of the longest subsequence common to two strings; characters need not be contiguous.
Find the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of an integer array.

questions.problem_title: Minimum Deletions to Make Strings Equal
questions.problem_statement: Find the minimum total number of character deletions needed to make two strings equal.
Find the minimum number of character insertions required to make a string a palindrome.
Find the minimum sum path from the top-left to bottom-right of a grid, moving only right or down.
Determine whether an array can be partitioned into two subsets having equal sums.
questions.output_format: true if an equal partition exists.

questions.problem_statement: Count paths from the top-left to bottom-right of an empty grid when movement is allowed only right or down.
Determine whether a string can be segmented into a sequence of words from a supplied dictionary.

questions.output_format: true if a valid segmentation exists.

questions.problem_statement: Choose two vertical lines that, together with the x-axis, hold the maximum possible water.
For each day's temperature, find how many days must pass until a warmer temperature. Use zero if none exists.

Design a stack supporting push, pop, top and retrieving the minimum element in constant time.

Design a stack supporting push, pop, top and empty using only queue operations.
For each array element, find the first greater element to its right; use -1 when none exists.
Find the median of two sorted arrays with logarithmic time complexity in the smaller array length.
In a sorted array, find the first and last index of a target value in logarithmic time.

questions.problem_statement: Find an index whose value is strictly greater than its existing neighbors. Assume adjacent values differ.
